Prod.ext.code: Prod.ext.{u_1, u_2} {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {x y : α × β} : x.1 = y.1 → x.2 = y.2 → x = y
Prod.ext.description: If two pairs of elements have equal first components and equal second components, then the pairs themselves are equal.

Sigma.ext.code: Sigma.ext.{u_1, u_2} : ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : α → Type u_2} {x y : Sigma β}, x.fst = y.fst → HEq x.snd y.snd → x = y
Sigma.ext.description: If two elements of a dependent pair have equal first components and their second components are similar in a hyper-equality sense, then the pairs themselves are equal.

Unit.ext.description: Any two elements of the trivial type are equal.
